The '''New Droids' Rights Movement''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] civil right movement [[Droid supremacy|against organic life forms]], organized by [[EV-8D3]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gavos]]. Some of it members tried to destroy the [[storm barrier generator]] to kill [[Miner/Legends|miners]] on the planet.
